title: Hearthline — stateful household mission control over MCP
tagline: A durable Alexa+ household mission orchestrator that keeps irreversible actions behind explicit human approval and idempotent execution.
problem: Household goals span multiple conversations and mix harmless reads with actions that could create real-world effects. A useful assistant needs durable mission state without silently turning conversational intent into a purchase, booking, notification, or other commitment.
solution: Hearthline is a self-hosted MCP 2025-11-25 Streamable HTTP server that combines live read-only context with durable household state, builds dependency-aware missions, rotates plan hashes after approval-state changes, and executes only explicitly approved demo actions with idempotency receipts.
